[public]: Not published: July 8-15, 1970; Aug. 8, 1973; and: last week of each Dec. 1970-1973.  [public]: Issue for July 11, 1973 lacks volume designation and called no. 27 in error, but constitutes vol. 14, no. 28.  [public]: Issues for Aug. 1-22, 1973 called vol. 14, no. 30-32 in error, but constitute no. 31-33.  [public]: Thank you to the St. Albert Gazette, the St. Albert Community Foundation, and the St. Albert Public Library for their generous contributions of funding for the digitization of this newspaper for the Peel's Prairie Province's website; to the St. Albert Gazette for providing issues in print, and to the Musée Héritage Museum and the St. Albert Public Library for providing microfilmed copies of the newspaper.
